interface.signature: def numoffbt(arr: list[int], n: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: All integers in arr are greater than 1.
The size of arr, n, is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= x <= 10**5 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in arr is between 2 and 10^5 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer representing the count of valid full binary trees modulo 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for x in arr) + sum(1 for x in arr for y in arr for z in arr if x * y == z)
postconditions.description: The return value counts all single-node trees (one per element in arr) plus all three-node trees where the root is the product of its two children (each child can be any element in arr).
The return value is the total count of valid full binary trees (including single-node and multi-node trees) modulo 1000000007.
